parameters: \rLorelei: Keep your filthy hands off the Pokémon in the cave!
\rDo as I say, or you'll have me to answer to!
\bAww, shut it, lady, and leave us be.
\bDon't let your glasses get all steamed up!
\rNo, we can catch up later.\nRight now, I need your help.
\rHelp me kick these poachers out before they do anything else.
\rThey've been catching Pokémon here, then selling them off!
\rAre you ready?\nYou take that one, please!
\bWho says we can't do what we want with the Pokémon we catch?
\rWhere have you taken the captured Pokémon?
\rI'm smashing your ring once and for all!
\rLorelei: If you won't confess, we'll deep-freeze you.
\rMy Lapras is furious for what you've done to its friends.
\bThe Pokémon are in the Rocket Warehouse on Five Island.
\bThere! I said it!\nWe'll be going now!
\b…But I doubt you'll ever make it into the Rocket Warehouse!
\rI was born and raised here on these islands.
\rI had no idea that those horrible criminals were loose here…
\rI'm… going to head back to my house.
